title: ShopCoach drafts lines with no typing, and its instructions are kept
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it: open a work order (Work Orders > New, pick a customer and unit), start an inspection from a template with a checkbox field, mark one field Not OK and one Monitor, then complete and sign it.
  3. Choose a target work order; also open the Line Builder started from a work order that has no inspection (Work Order > Lines > Line Builder), for comparison.
custom_steps:
1. Go through the whole build flow and confirm there is no prompt, query box or configuration step — the user never types to get lines.
2. Confirm the build action reads as an AI action before pressing (purple treatment, AI badge) and its label does not name the product.
3. Confirm ShopCoach is named once, at the destination-choice step, and nowhere else.
4. Confirm the written brief on the work-order Line Builder (no inspection) is not removed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The user never types anything to get lines — there is no prompt, query box or configuration step anywhere in this flow.
  • The build trigger reads as an AI action before it is pressed (the purple treatment and the AI badge), and its label does not name the product.
  • ShopCoach is named once, at the step where the destination is chosen, and nowhere else in the flow.
  • The written brief a user can type on the work-order Line Builder is not removed; typing is removed from the inspection flow only.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-R4: “The user will never type anything to get lines. There is no prompt, no query box and no configuration step anywhere in this flow”
  • S15-R5: “The action that starts the build will read as an AI action before it is pressed, carrying the purple treatment and the AI badge. The label will not name the product”
  • S15-R6: “ShopCoach will be named once, at the step where the destination is chosen, and nowhere else in the flow”
  • S15-N5: “The written brief a user can type on the Line Builder started from a work order is not removed. S15-R4 removes it from the inspection flow only. It is the only way a service advisor with no inspection to hand gets lines, and that flow is out of scope for this epic”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
